---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for Phantom Mesh
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you would like.

## Motivation

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve or what workflow does it improve?

## Proposed Solution

Describe your preferred approach. If this involves a new tool, provider, or hand (workflow), indicate which category it falls into:

- [ ] New tool (`src/tools/`)
- [ ] New provider (`src/providers/`)
- [ ] New hand / workflow (`~/.phantom-mesh/hands/`)
- [ ] Core improvement (agent runtime, cluster, security, etc.)
- [ ] Other

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional Context

Any other context, references, mockups, or examples that help illustrate the feature.
